name: Coin tosses
description: What does a handful of tosses tell us about the next ten?

source.text:
def coin(heads, trials):
    bias = numpyro.sample("bias", dist.Beta(2, 2))
    numpyro.deterministic("expected", trials * bias)
    numpyro.sample("heads", dist.Binomial(trials, bias), obs=jnp.asarray(heads))
